conventions.commits: Conventional commits (type(scope): subject, e.g. feat(core): add Swift language support with tree-sitter-swift handler (#1742)); every commit carries a Signed-off-by DCO trailer (verified on recent commits); GPG signature required per the issue (recent commits show signature status E = present but not verified in this clone).
conventions.testing: Inline #[cfg(test)] mod tests at the bottom of each languages/<lang>.rs (parse helper with tree_sitter::Parser, Query::new(...).expect("must be valid") to prove queries compile, QueryCursor matches); registry tests in languages/mod.rs and lang.rs; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/ using common::call_tool_raw and tempfile; The CI coverage job installs cargo-nextest (ci.yml lines 177-181); the main test invocation was not read.
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --locked --profile ci -- -D warnings -W clippy::cognitive_complexity; workspace lints deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (test code exempt via cfg_attr); clippy.toml cognitive-complexity-threshold = 30; SPDX-FileCopyrightText and SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 header required on every .rs file under crates/; REUSE.toml annotations; jscpd duplicate check ignores **/languages/**.
conventions.error_handling: Handlers return Option or Vec (no Result); unsupported or invalid input yields None/empty, never panic; get_node_text and bounds-checked slices (end_byte <= source.len()); ParserError::UnsupportedLanguage and ParserError::QueryError for registry and query failures; unwrap_used and expect_used denied outside tests.

patterns: Per-language module under languages/ exports ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as &'static str consts (java.rs lines 4-34).
Registry is two hand-written match tables: get_language_info() returns LanguageInfo with Option fields; get_ts_language() returns the raw Language. Both must list the language.
Optional capabilities are expressed as None (css: defuse_query None, extract_inheritance None; markdown and yaml the same), so a grammar can ship with a subset of queries.

Captures are matched by name, not position: element 'function' + 'func_name'|'method_name' and 'class' + 'class_name'|'type_name'; call 'call'; import 'import_path'; def-use prefixes 'write.', 'read.', 'writeread.'.
extract_inheritance(node, source) -> Vec<String> with 'extends X' / 'implements X' prefixes (java.rs 131-165); swift.rs guards on node.kind() before walking.
Extension to language mapping is a single const slice (EXTENSION_MAP) plus supported_languages(); schema pattern is derived from EXTENSION_MAP automatically.
Grammar crates are workspace dependencies declared once in root Cargo.toml and referenced with { workspace = true } in crates/aptu-coder-core/Cargo.toml.
Inline HTML tolerance: html.rs is a stub and markdown/css ship as separate grammars; new grammars are added whole, not via feature flags (lang-* gates removed in #1235).

constraints: Pick tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 (published 2026-11-19, so over 7 days old at HEAD date 2026-11-28); its Cargo.toml depends only on tree-sitter-language = "0.1", which is already locked at 0.1.9, so it is compatible with workspace tree-sitter 0.27.2.
Use LANGUAGE_PHP (not LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY) so inline HTML parses as text nodes; the acceptance criterion for mixed HTML/PHP with zero ERROR nodes depends on this choice.

"php" must be added to supported_languages() in lang.rs; parser.rs builds QUERY_CACHE from that list and returns UnsupportedLanguage for any name missing from it. Note css and yaml are missing from that list today (observed by reading, not executed).

DEFUSE_QUERY is typed Option<&str>, so the compiler does not force it; it is required by issue scope and acceptance, and without it extract_def_use_for_file silently returns an empty Vec (parser.rs 562-564).

PHP variables are variable_name nodes wrapping name; capture text is the bare name without the leading $, so a def-use symbol must be passed as 'x' not '$x' (parser_elements.rs 873-876 compares node text to symbol_name).

Handlers that receive the @class capture also receive interface_declaration, trait_declaration and enum_declaration nodes (parser_elements.rs 398-402), so extract_inheritance must accept all four kinds, not only class_declaration.
The issue states external PRs are not accepted and the maintainers implement it in-house; this report is for internal planning only.

Keep scope to the issue: no edits to tool handlers or schemas (AGENTS.md Do not), no new dependencies beyond tree-sitter-php, new Cargo.lock entries need >= 7 days age (SKIP_PACKAGE_AGE_CHECK must not be used).
Every .rs file under crates/ must carry the SPDX-FileCopyrightText and SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 header (ci.yml lint job).
test_coverage: Each language module has inline unit tests: java.rs covers extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, the element query happy path, extract_inheritance and a defuse write site; swift.rs covers element query and inheritance; css.rs covers element and import extraction and the empty-file edge case. languages/mod.rs has test_get_language_info_known, _unknown, test_get_ts_language_known and _unknown, and a table-driven test that checks name, reference_query and import_query presence for tsx, fortran, markdown, css and yaml (no php entry yet). lang.rs tests language_for_extension happy path and edge cases plus the schema pattern covering every EXTENSION_MAP entry. Integration coverage per language lives in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs (for example test_integration_tsx_analyze_file at line 3138) and per-tool structured-content tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/analyze_file_fields_summary.rs and analyze_module_structured_content_tests.rs (file names only; contents not read for per-language coverage). parser.rs has a lazy-compilation test (delta < supported_languages().len()). No existing test checks that a language is absent from supported_languages() while present in get_language_info(). Tests were not executed during this read-only scout run.

library_findings.notes: Context7 confirmed Query::new and capture_names signatures. Query::new fails at runtime on an unknown node kind or field, so the per-query compile unit test is the only guard against a typo such as a wrong field name. Field-less children (base_clause, class_interface_clause) cannot be reached via child_by_field_name; iterate node.child(i) and match kind().

library_findings.relevant_api: queries/tags.scm defines definition.interface (interface_declaration name: (name)), definition.interface (trait_declaration name: (name)), definition.class (class_declaration name: (name)), definition.function (function_definition name: (name)), definition.function (method_declaration name: (name)), reference.call (function_call_expression function: name|qualified_name|variable_name; scoped_call_expression name: (name); member_call_expression name: (name)), reference.implementation (class_interface_clause [(name) (qualified_name)]). It has NO enum_declaration pattern.
library_findings.notes: tags.scm is a ready-made cross-check for names and kinds but is not usable verbatim: its capture names are not the ones parser_elements.rs dispatches on, and it omits enum. Keywords are matched case-insensitively (keyword(word) builds new RegExp(word, 'i')).

approaches.name: A: Full Java-style handler (recommended)
approaches.description: New languages/php.rs mirroring java.rs: ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, method_declaration, class/interface/trait/enum declarations as @class), CALL_QUERY (function_call_expression, member_call_expression, nullsafe_member_call_expression, scoped_call_expression), REFERENCE_QUERY (named_type), IMPORT_QUERY (namespace_use_declaration), DEFUSE_QUERY (variable_name based), and extract_inheritance that accepts class, interface, trait and enum nodes and walks field-less base_clause and class_interface_clause children. Wire php in lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP (php -> php), supported_languages(), languages/mod.rs (pub mod, get_language_info arm with LANGUAGE_PHP, get_ts_language arm), add tree-sitter-php to root and crate Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock. Inline unit tests plus one integration test file. Skip extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver and find_receiver_type as the issue excludes them.
pros: Matches every acceptance criterion in issue #1864, including DEFUSE_QUERY and the HTML-template case.
Same shape as java.rs and swift.rs, so review burden and reviewer familiarity are low.
Query compile tests catch wrong node kinds or fields immediately, which the issue suggests as step 3.
Uses LANGUAGE_PHP so inline HTML is tolerated without a separate grammar.
cons: DEFUSE_QUERY on variable_name nodes has the symbol-name caveat (no leading $) and ordering-dependent read/write dedupe, so a def-use test with a real assignment is needed.
Calls and reads will include method names if the query is widened carelessly; keep reads scoped to variable_name.
Cargo.lock churn plus a binary size delta to report.

approaches.name: B: Minimal element, call and import only (defuse None)
approaches.description: Same as A but DEFUSE_QUERY is omitted (defuse_query: None), as css.rs, markdown and fortran do. Only ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY and extract_inheritance, with REFERENCE_QUERY optional.
pros: Smallest diff and fewest queries to get right; lowest risk of a def-use false positive.
Precedented by css, markdown and fortran, which set defuse_query to None.
cons: Violates the issue scope and acceptance, which list DEFUSE_QUERY among the five required constants.
Without DEFUSE_QUERY, extract_def_use_for_file returns an empty Vec silently (parser.rs 562-564), so any def-use consumer gets no PHP results with no error.
Would need a follow-up PR to add defuse, so it does not finish the issue.

approaches.name: C: Seed queries from grammar tags.scm with LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY
approaches.description: Derive ELEMENT and CALL queries from the grammar's queries/tags.scm (definition.* and reference.* patterns), rename captures to the names parser_elements.rs dispatches on, add an enum pattern by hand, and use tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY to avoid the HTML-text question.
pros: Query text tracks the grammar maintainers' own naming, which may survive future grammar renames better.
PHP_ONLY grammar has no text nodes, so the parse tree is smaller for pure PHP files.
cons: PHP_ONLY rejects or mis-parses inline HTML, which fails the explicit acceptance criterion for a mixed .php file with zero ERROR nodes.
tags.scm has no enum pattern and uses captures that do not match parser_elements.rs, so the rename step is still manual.
Adds a second grammar entry point (LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY) that no other language in the registry uses.

recommendation: Approach A. It is the only option that meets every acceptance criterion in #1864 (five queries including DEFUSE_QUERY, extract_inheritance for all four declaration kinds, LANGUAGE_PHP for the mixed HTML case). It copies the java.rs shape exactly and keeps the wiring identical to the swift and css precedents. Add php to supported_languages() in the same change; otherwise parser.rs returns UnsupportedLanguage. Keep the workspace dependency at tree-sitter-php 0.25.2, which is already over 7 days old.

inheritance_walk_citation: Grammar source: php/src/node-types.json (tree-sitter-php 0.25.2) and php grammar rules in common/define-grammar.js. Walk for class_declaration: (1) node.child_by_field_name("name") gives the class name (field name, type name). (2) class_declaration has NO field names on its clauses; its children include base_clause and class_interface_clause, which are found by iterating node.child(i) and matching kind(). (3) base_clause children are name | qualified_name | relative_name (node-types.json lists these as children with multiple=true, required=true); base_clause is seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name)) in define-grammar.js, so for a class it holds the superclass; emit "extends {text}" for each named child. (4) class_interface_clause children are name | qualified_name | relative_name; its rule is seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name)); emit "implements {text}" for each named child. (5) field body = declaration_list, not walked. Same walk for interface_declaration (base_clause only, emit "extends"), enum_declaration (class_interface_clause only, field body = enum_declaration_list), trait_declaration (no clauses). Keyword matching is case-insensitive (keyword() builds RegExp with 'i'). Expected: class Foo extends Bar implements A, B yields ["extends Bar", "implements A", "implements B"]; class with no clause yields [].
